title: Chat proxy maxDuration residual — long confirms false-fail

confirm_via_chat.risk: Wall-clock maxDuration covers entire stream; UI spinner errors when proxy kills the function even if backend is healthy

confirm_via_execute_button.note: Bypasses /api/chat maxDuration; STA-307 measured ~1159ms for all-skipped confirm

fix.change: Raise /api/chat maxDuration from 120 → 300 (literal segment config export only — Next.js rejects extra named exports from route files)
fix.rationale: Same class as notifications SSE; does not invent a second confirm path; removes silent false-fail class for long chat confirms and tool-heavy turns
non_goals: Does not raise backend latency budget
Does not claim provider-side stream can run forever — 300s is the shared Vercel Pro-style ceiling already used in-app

prior_prod.false_fail_class: chat proxy 120s vs fast backend execute

verdict: PASS — ceiling raised; regression locks ≥300 and ≥ notifications stream
